title: Grand Cru Car Wash: Now Pouring in the Temecula Valley

characters.name: The Wash Sommelier
characters.visual_lock: Car wash attendant in their 30s with a neat dark beard, styled like a sommelier: black vest over a crisp white shirt, burgundy tie, a silver tastevin cup on a chain around the neck, bright blue nitrile gloves

characters.name: The Driver
characters.visual_lock: Driver in their 60s with silver hair, wide straw sun hat, cream linen shirt, sunglasses pushed up on the forehead; drives a dusty champagne-colored sedan

locations.name: Vineyard road, Temecula Valley
locations.description: Two-lane country road between rows of grapevines on rolling golden hills, scattered oak trees, a hot-air balloon drifting in the morning sky

locations.name: Grand Cru wash tunnel, exit bay
locations.description: Express car wash tunnel exit: tall burgundy and champagne foam brushes, a chrome arch, drying blowers, polished concrete floor, a small wooden podium with a menu card

visual_rules.lighting_key: Bright Southern California morning sun with soft haze over the hills; inside the bay, cool overhead light with warm sun spilling in from the exit
visual_rules.style_prompt: glossy wine-commercial photography played completely straight, golden morning light, shallow depth of field, 35mm, deadpan luxury
visual_rules.negative_prompt: lettering, signage, writing, logo, watermark, cartoon, cgi, 3d render, plastic skin, extra fingers, deformed hands

exclusions: No naming or mocking real wineries or businesses
